title: AI For Everyone Course Review

title: NBA Data Analysis with PowerBI
content: I'm happy to share this NBA DATA ANALYSIS project I worked on during my time at Teesside University. I analyzed a dataset from Kaggle of the National Basketball Association (NBA) players, that highlights all their statistics through ten seasons using the many features of Microsoft PowerBI. I utilized features of PowerBI to import data, create and manipulate tables with the in-built features and the DAX language, build relationships between tables, make predictive analysis, use different charts to highlight various player and league statistics and finally build dashboards to form a fully rounded report.
